### (a) Bubble-point Temperature

\[ \sum x_i K_i = 1 \]

\[ x_1 = \frac{w_1}{M_1}/\sum \left( \frac{w_i}{M_i} \right), \quad x_2 = \frac{w_2}{M_2}/\sum \left( \frac{w_i}{M_i} \right), \quad x_3 = \frac{w_3}{M_3}/\sum \left( \frac{w_i}{M_i} \right) \]

Calculate the normalization constant:
\[ \sum \left( \frac{w_i}{M_i} \right) = \frac{0.30}{78.11} + \frac{0.40}{92.14} + \frac{0.30}{106.17} = 0.00533 + 0.00434 + 0.00283 = 0.0125 \]

Then, the mole fractions:
\[ x_1 = \frac{0.30/78.11}{0.0125} = 0.4264 \]
\[ x_2 = \frac{0.40/92.14}{0.0125} = 0.3474 \]
\[ x_3 = \frac{0.30/106.17}{0.0125} = 0.2262 \]
